title: Fall Out Boy announce their biggest world tour yet for 2027
summary: The Twilight of the Punks tour has 36 stadium and arena dates in Europe, the UK and North America.
body:
Fall Out Boy have announced a 36-date world tour for 2027, described as the biggest headline run of their career. The band also released a new single, "Aces".

The Twilight of the Punks tour was announced on 9 November. It begins in Prague on 17 May and visits 11 European countries, including a show at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London on 5 June.

North American stadiums

The North American leg starts in Arlington, Texas, on 13 July and includes Soldier Field in Chicago, Fenway Park in Boston and Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.

A Day To Remember and Neck Deep will support in Europe and the UK. The Offspring, Good Charlotte and The Story So Far join the band on most North American dates.

Sources: BroadwayWorld, Yahoo Entertainment, The Music Universe.
